title: MT Aurora Sun struck by limpet mine off Bandar Abbas
summary: Liberian-flagged tanker reports explosion at port-side hull plate. Crew safe, vessel adrift. UKMTO advisory issued; CENTCOM rerouting MQ-9 patrol.

title: Anti-ship missile splashes 600m from VLCC Eternal Star
summary: IRGC-launched cruise missile fell short of Marshall Islands-flagged VLCC transiting eastbound TSS. No injuries. Master diverted to UAE waters.

title: UKMTO Advisory 024/26 — Heightened threat to merchant shipping
summary: All flags advised to maintain maximum vigilance, BMP5 hard. Two-hour reporting cycle to UKMTO until further notice.

title: IMSCC: Two-ship convoy lanes activated for eastbound transit
summary: International Maritime Security Construct opens escorted lanes between waypoint H1 and H4. Pre-registration via Bahrain ops cell required.

title: USS Bulkeley escorts seven-ship eastbound convoy through Hormuz
summary: Arleigh Burke-class destroyer leads first publicly-acknowledged escort since 2019. Convoy includes two LNG carriers under Greek flag.

title: Drone strike disables tanker Pacific Gem in Gulf of Oman
summary: Marshall Islands-flagged product tanker reports unmanned aerial system impact on bridge wing. Two crew injured; vessel under tow to Fujairah.

title: MARAD Maritime Advisory 2026-007: Avoid Iranian territorial waters
summary: US-flagged vessels strongly advised to avoid 12nm IRGC-controlled coastal band. Pre-position security teams; activate AIS even in declared zones.

title: IRGC fast boats board chemical tanker Blue Glory near Hengam
summary: Eight IRGC small craft boarded Panamanian-flagged chemical tanker; crew detained briefly. Vessel released after six hours, transit resumed.

title: Houthi cruise missile shadows MV Koryo Ace through Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint
summary: Combined Task Force 153 frigate intercepts inbound missile 12nm off vessel. No damage. Owner suspends Red Sea-Gulf rotation pending review.

title: CENTCOM stands up dedicated escort task element for Hormuz
summary: Task Element 153.2 to provide 24/7 escort coverage during heightened threat period. Two destroyers and three patrol craft committed.

title: JS Akizuki conducts close escort for two Japanese-flagged LNG carriers
summary: Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force destroyer maintains 1nm screen for return leg. Tokyo coordinates rotation with US 5th Fleet.

title: Tanker Southern Pearl hit by uncrewed surface vessel south of Larak
summary: USV strike causes flooding to forepeak. Crew contains damage; vessel proceeds to Khor Fakkan under own power.
